qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Unrivaled brand equity and technician loyalty supported by over 4,800 franchised mobile vans providing direct-to-bay sales, financing, and lifetime warranty service. Proven by a 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 20.0%, tangible ROIC of 26-28%, and steady 50-51% gross margins across cycles. Primary risks include technician demographic aging, low-cost e-commerce tool competition, and OEM proprietary diagnostic lock-out.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. The premier brand in professional mechanic tools with iconic franchised van distribution, sustained ~20% GAAP ROIC, and net cash balance sheet. Insulated from AI disruption as physical maintenance and complex diagnostics remain indispensable. [5-10Y g: auto repair volume 1.5% + diagnostic software & OEM mix 2.5% + pricing power 2.0% + net buybacks 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 20.0% with operating ROIC exceeding 26%. Multi-year Owner FCF conversion exceeds 95% ($7.6B Owner FCF generated vs $7.5B Net Income over 2016-2025). Fortress balance sheet with $1.62B cash against $1.19B debt (net cash position) and interest coverage above 26x. Peak-to-peak earnings power expanded from $9.39 EPS in 2016 to $19.78 EPS in 2024. Disciplined capital allocation under long-serving CEO Nick Pinchuk with minimal dilution, low capex (~1.5% of revenue), and 15+ years of consecutive dividend growth.
